name: The Warsaw Pact's ground forces against Pannonia: a combined arms army of the front
status: F3.1 (21 Nov 2026): data only (docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md section 11). Nothing reads it on the campaign path until F3.3; simcore/ground_war/ground_data.hpp loads it and tests/test_ground_data.cpp checks it.
source: the army's make-up from fm_100_2_1_1984 pp. 4-4 to 4-7 (two to four motor rifle and one or two tank divisions); the divisions' organisation as NATO saw it (fm100_2_3, organisation only), their numbers placeholders; doctrine from fm_100_2_1_1984, reznichenko_1984, mt_kurkov_tank_army, mt_stashek_losses and mt_novoselov_replacement (docs/research/fronts_2026-11/pact_ground.md); the invasion of Pannonia is the game's fiction and its plan a SAM3D estimate
notes: Units, names and numbers are placeholders as the factions' aircraft are. Equipment types are the strength weights' ids (data/gameplay/ground_war.json); they have no basic models yet (F5.2). Every place is the country map's (place_map, F1): garrisons, routes and objectives name its settlements, landmarks and sites, and the loader refuses one it lacks. Each axis names the sector of the front (the theatre's, F2.1) it attacks in.

oob.name: The combined arms army of the Northern Group of Forces
oob.source: fm_100_2_1_1984 pp. 4-4 to 4-7 (an army of two to four motor rifle and one or two tank divisions); the regiments and their equipment of the order of the NATO view (fm100_2_3), numbers placeholders
oob.notes: Three motor rifle divisions and a tank division, each of four manoeuvre regiments and an artillery regiment; the division's own troops (its independent tank battalion, reconnaissance, engineers, signals and rear) on the division itself. Garrisons are the assembly areas before the war.

services.name: The ground forces of the Northern Group of Forces

personnel.basis: estimate: the army's artillery brigade, rocket and support troops
estimate: the division's own troops and its independent tank battalion

estimate: the division's own troops and its independent tank battalion

pool.source: game value: the Pact's commanders drawn as its air officers are (data/air_war/faction_warsaw_pact.json officer_pool); rigid, by the norms, little flexibility below regiment (fm_100_2_1_1984 ch. 2)

authored.name: Pavel Gromov
authored.background: Tank troops, Frunze and General Staff Academies
authored.bio: Commanded a tank division in the Carpathian district. Plans to the hour and holds his divisions to the norms.

authored.name: Oleg Tarasov
authored.bio: Came back from Afghanistan with a taste for night attacks and little patience for staff work.

authored.name: Viktor Belov
authored.bio: The army's exploitation force; waits to be committed and wants it to be on the axis that moves.

attack_ratio.source: fm_100_2_1_1984 pp. 2-10 to 2-11: about 3:1 in combat power, a minimum 3:1 at each level of attack

breakthrough_ratio.source: reznichenko_1984 p. 79: WWII densities hardly possible now; local massing capped at 3-5:1 (pact_ground.md section 4)

withdraw_needs_order.source: reznichenko_1984 pp. 49, 152: only with the senior commander's permission

counterattack_by_senior.source: reznichenko_1984 pp. 177-179; fm_100_2_1_1984 p. 6-3: the next higher commander's

second_echelon_to_success.source: fm_100_2_1_1984 p. 2-11: second echelons reinforce success, not failure

echelons_against_deep_defence.source: fm_100_2_1_1984 pp. 2-10 to 2-11: two echelons against a defence in depth, one and a reserve against a shallow one

reserve_share.source: fm_100_2_1_1984 p. 2-11: a combined-arms reserve of about a ninth of the force

degraded_below.source: mt_novoselov_replacement p. 9: effective status kept at two thirds of authorised strength; below it degraded and replaced first

ineffective_below.source: mt_stashek_losses p. 7: still effective under 40-50% losses; below half ineffective, withdrawn and re-formed

hq_hit_ineffective_below.source: mt_stashek_losses p. 7: ineffective at about 24-25% losses when command, rockets and artillery are hit

breakthrough.source: mt_kurkov_tank_army p. 9; fm_100_2_1_1984 p. 4-4: 25-30 km a day breaking through a defence

depth.source: mt_kurkov_tank_army p. 9: 40-50 km a day in the operational depth

broken.source: mt_1967_volkov_nonnuclear p. 13-14: 50-70 km a day, only against a broken enemy (pact_ground.md section 4)

frontages_km.source: fm_100_2_1_1984 pp. 5-18 to 5-20: the division's attack zone
fm_100_2_1_1984 pp. 5-18 to 5-21: a breakthrough on 6-10 km

start_after_h.source: SAM3D estimate: the owner's open decision 3 taken as proposed (docs/fronts/README.md): the Pact's ground offensive opens with its air operation, two hours after the first massed blow

plan.source: SAM3D estimate: the axes and objectives are the game's fiction on the country map; the depths by fm_100_2_1_1984 fig. p. 4-4 (the division's day 25-30 km; the army's immediate objective 100-150 km in 3-4 days)
plan.notes: The main thrust down the north-eastern road to Mezovar and the capital; and a supporting attack down the Rava gorge past the dam to Dravec. The tank division follows the main thrust as the second echelon and goes to the axis that moves.

objectives.name: Dravec and the dam
objectives.notes: The supporting attack's day objective (25-30 km).

objectives.name: Mezovar and the Tisava crossing
objectives.notes: The main thrust's first divisions' objective.

objectives.name: The capital
objectives.notes: The army's immediate objective, about 100 km in.
